verdict.rationale: UK Visas and Immigration is a government immigration authority, not a configurable data service. Letting applicants pick a storage region or residency for their records is a category error for this kind of product. The only privacy-related item, a page on seeing the personal information UKVI holds, is about data access, not residency choice, so it does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
